inj.note: Lewis likely picked up the injury during Sunday's 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers. He was unable to practice all week due to his injury, and with Torricelli Simpkins (ankle) also ruled out, Corey Bullock figures to step into the starting role at left guard. Lewis' next chance to play is Week 9 against the Broncos on Sunday, Nov. 8.

news.h: Pass rusher Jaelan Phillips among four Panthers ruled out for TNF vs. Packers
news.d: The Panthers ruled out four players, including starting OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and left guard Damien Lewis (knee) for "Thursday Night Football."
